description: parse normalizes symbols/aliases and builds E with precedence or < and < comparison < add < mul/mod < unary < right-associated power < postfix. Unknown f(x) is multiplication. eval returns V or String while updating Env vars/subs/steps/approx. Exact Q arithmetic switches to R for nonexact powers/transcendentals. And/or/if are lazy. Inclusive ranged forms restore bound variables on normal exit, but errors retain the current binding. Ordinary calls evaluate arguments before arity and flat_args/fact/at can evaluate again. CRT writes crt_modulus. independent prefers integer residue modulo 2^61-1 then finite f64 tolerance 1e-9 max(1,|result|).
